    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Backports #36312 in src/net_processing.cpp and src/netgroup.cpp to keep private broadcast connections outside normal address discouragement handling.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents misbehaving private broadcast peers from triggering full IP discouragement against normal peer connections while still disconnecting them."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Corrects non-literal hints in OpenRPC schema metadata without altering RPC functional behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

    },

      "name": "tools",

      "evidence": "Changes under contrib are build and codesigning scripts which belong to the build category.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Contrib scripts touched are release and build tooling rather than standalone CLI tools or operator scripts."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Backports #36322 touching src/init.cpp to fix shutdown sequencing between fee estimation unregistration and validation callback draining.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures queued validation callbacks drain before saving and unregistering fee estimation on shutdown, preventing missing tip updates from invalidating saved estimates across restarts."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",

      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Speeds up canonical descriptor comparisons by caching descriptor string hashes in memory rather than recomputing the string on each comparison."
    }
